Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our procurement and legal teams asked us to consolidate the MSA/DPA/SOW inputs so we can move to signature. Attached are our internal comments and the draft SOW with technical acceptance criteria. Two asks from our side: 1) confirm Redwood can accept the subprocessor transparency clause with a carve-out for managed infra partners, and 2) can you confirm data retention controls for embeddings used in indexing?

We'd like to get to a mutual set of redlines by EOD Friday so procurement can route for approvals. Evan

Evan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and clear asks. I'm looping in Marissa (partner ops) and Ben (sales lead) and Laura (contracts) to coordinate internal redlines and procurement items. Initial responses inline below; we'll provide a consolidated MSA/DPA/SOW packet by close of business Thursday so you have time to review before Friday.

Quick notes:
- Subprocessor clause: Redwood's standard approach is to disclose managed infra partners and provide customer notification; we can accept a narrow carve-out for cloud partners we already use (AWS/GCP) but will not agree to an unrestricted carve-out. Laura, please advise on exact language we should propose.
- Embeddings retention: we offer configurable retention windows and a default 30-day ephemeral KV cache; for HorizonForge we can propose a 90-day indexed retention with options to shorten via SOW. Technical acceptance criteria in the SOW need to reflect that.

I'll attach our annotated MSA/DPA and a draft SOW that maps to the integration milestones you showed in the demo.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: kickoff & legal docs for Redwood integration

Team —

I've reviewed HorizonForge's markups and prepared a redline (attached) with three items to defend and two we can be flexible on. Summary:
1) Subprocessor clause — counter with a requirement for prior notification of material changes + list of currently approved subprocessors. We will not accept an open carve-out.
2) Indemnity cap — propose cap tied to 12 months of fees; can be reduced for strategic partnerships if Ben confirms commercials.
3) Data retention & deletion — accept SOW-level retention terms; require standard audit rights (limited to scope) and proof of deletion for indexed embeddings.
4) Security questionnaire — HorizonForge asked for SOC2 evidence; we will provide SOC2 Type II summary and a redacted controls matrix.
5) SOW acceptance criteria — recommend tightening the acceptance tests for indexing success (sample recall thresholds + latency SLAs for queries).

I uploaded the MSA redline as "HorizonForge_MSA_redlines_v3.docx" and an annotated DPA spreadsheet "DPA-annotated.xlsx". Kimberly: please confirm whether we want to offer a short-term credits concession for acceptance by 5/10 (sales ask).

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Folks —

Thanks Laura, that redline looks good. Commercials note: Prospect is targeted for a mid-June POC and we want to keep pricing simple for the pilot (monthly committed capacity + overage). I'm ok offering a one-time onboarding credit of $10k if they sign the proposed terms by 2027-05-10. That should be enough to close procurement while preserving margin. Marissa, can you confirm SOW milestones map to billing triggers?

High-level to Evan/ Priya: if you agree to the carve-outs and the retention window discussed, we'll escalate to a signature packet with a starter SOW and credit note.

- Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Strategic Partners

Subject: Final: consolidated redlines + next steps (MSA/DPA/SOW)

Evan / Priya —

Attached are the consolidated redlines and SOW that reflect the compromises we discussed:
- MSA: we provided narrow carve-out language for known cloud partners + requirement for notice of new subprocessors.
- DPA: agreed SOW-level retention default of 90 days; HorizonForge can request shorter retention in the SOW. Audit rights limited to scoped evidence and SOC2 summary.
- SOW: added objective acceptance criteria (sample recall >= 78% on provided test set) and 99ms median query latency target for the pilot tier; billing triggers linked to milestone acceptance.

Commercial concession: Ben confirmed a one-time $10k onboarding credit if HorizonForge returns signatures by EOD 2027-05-10. If procurement needs additional approvals, please escalate and we'll support.

Next steps:
1) Review attached packet and confirm redlines by 5/06.
2) If accepted, we'll prepare DocuSign envelope and issue the credit note.
3) Kickoff POC week of 6/14 pending signature.

Thanks — look forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
